users.howTo: Every session and app token of the account ends at once, the invites it knows stop working, and an admin loses the admin rights. Lifting the suspension lets it sign in again, without admin rights. It can no longer export or delete its data itself: its owner writes to the contact address, and the operator does it by hand, as the notice-and-takedown runbook describes (“Accounts that cannot sign in”).
